stem:
On the grid, draw a line parallel to line L.

[Image: A grid with line L]

descriptors: Other incorrect (including crossed out/erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

figure_description: A grid measuring 11 squares wide by 6 squares high. A straight line segment with arrowheads at both ends is labeled L near its upper-right end. The line follows the diagonals of grid squares at a 45-degree angle (slope of 1), extending from the grid intersection located 3 units from the left and 2 units from the bottom to the intersection located 6 units from the left and 5 units from the bottom.
